OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

<groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <!-- RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <version>${maven.openapi-generator-plugin.version}</version>
                <!-- /RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>
                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>
                                <useSpringBoot3>true</useSpringBoot3>
                                <useJakartaEe>true</useJakartaEe>
                                <openApiNullable>false</openApiNullable>
                                <!-- override the default library to jersey2 -->
                                <serializationLibrary>jackson</serializationLibrary>

                            </configOptions>
                        </configuration>

The build passes with all tests green. Here's a summary of the change.

## What I did

Implemented required-field validation for `POST /api/owners` following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection pattern (per AGENTS.md), rejecting any create that is missing or blank in `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` with a `400` whose JSON body carries an `errors` array of the offending field names.

**New files:**
- `function/owner/ValidateOwnerFields.java` — new first pipeline step. Reads the body once, checks each of the five required fields (null-or-blank via `isBlank()`), throws a checked `MissingOwnerFieldsException` listing the bad fields, and otherwise republishes the body as `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>` for downstream steps.
- `escalation/MissingOwnerFieldsException.java` — checked exception carrying the field-name list.
- `escalation/MissingOwnerFieldsExceptionHandler.java` — responds `400` with an `errors` property, reusing the existing `ProblemDetails.build(...)` helper so the body stays consistent with the other escalation handlers.
- `officefloor/escalation/...MissingOwnerFieldsException.yml` — wires the exception to its handler.

**Modified:**
- `owners.POST.yml` — inserted the `validate` step ahead of `build`.
- `BuildOwner.java` — now consumes the validated body via `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` instead of re-binding `@RequestBody` (the body may only be read once per pipeline).

## Design notes
- The validation lives in its own single-responsibility step; the check helper is a small private method keyed off the OpenAPI-required field set, so no class became a catch-all.
- I deliberately bind the body **without** `@Valid` in this step so that a missing required field surfaces as *my* `errors`-shaped 400 rather than being preempted by the generic bean-validation handler (which emits a differently-shaped `schemaValidationErrors` body). Blank values like `"   "` are caught by `isBlank()`, which plain `@NotNull`/`@Size(min=1)` would not catch.

All tests pass: the missing-`city` case returns 400 with `errors` containing `"city"`, blank telephone returns 400, and a complete owner succeeds.
